Discover how Leif Soreide achieved a +222% return in just 27 days using the High-Tight Flag (HTF) trading setup. In this deep-dive session, Leif explains how he identifies explosive stocks, times entries with precision, and manages risk while scaling into winners. Learn how to recognize tight consolidations, inside days, and volume contractions—key signals that institutions are accumulating shares before a breakout. Whether you're a swing trader or a momentum investor, this strategy provides a repeatable edge for trading high-growth stocks.

✅ How to identify High-Tight Flags (HTFs) before they break out
